284046408.description:
Sheaffer Targa 1060 Imperial Brass Fountain Pen
Vintage Luxury Writing Instrument with 14K Gold Nib
Solid Lacquered Brass, With Fitted Cases & Box
Introduced in the 1980s, the Sheaffer Targa Imperial Brass is among the most sought-after variants of the iconic Targa line. Renowned for its sleek cylindrical silhouette and signature inlaid nib, this model features heavy lacquered brass construction. It comes complete with its matching brass travel case, brass cartridge case, and presentation box.
Polished brass barrel and cap with inlaid 14K gold nib marked "SHEAFFER USA 585 14K"
Matching brass hinged travel case embossed with Imperial Brass logo
Matching brass cartridge case with four vintage Sheaffer Skrip cartridges
Original black Sheaffer presentation box with Imperial Brass plaque
Condition:
Pen finish retains bright luster with light handling marks. Inlaid 14K gold nib is straight and intact with tipping present. Brass cases latch securely with light surface patina. Original presentation box is clean and structurally sound with minor shelf wear.
